ops.text:
9A. Indemnification.

9A.1 HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Site or any services, software, tools, materials or deliverables provided by HDI hereunder infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right (other than Content or Marks provided by the Company); (b) HDI's breach of applicable law, rules or regulations; (c) any unauthorized access to, use or disclosure of Confidential Information, Content or customer or user data caused by HDI; or (d) HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

9A.2 The Company shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless HDI from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Content or Marks provided by the Company infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; or (b) the Company's breach of applicable law, rules or regulations.

9A.3 The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of any claim for which indemnification is sought, the indemnifying Party shall have control of the defense and settlement of the claim (provided that no settlement that imposes any liability or obligation on, or requires any admission by, the indemnified Party shall be made without its prior written consent), and the indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense and may participate in the defense with counsel of its own choosing at its own expense. This Section 9A shall survive the expiration or termination of this Agreement.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership of Content, Deliverables and Data. (a) As between the Parties, the Company owns and shall retain all right, title and interest in and to the Content, the Marks, all materials relating to the Deerskin Products, and all designs, text, graphics, layout, look and feel and other deliverables and work product created or developed by or for HDI specifically for the Company or the Site under this Agreement (collectively, the "Company Materials"), and HDI hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest it may have in and to the Company Materials. (b) HDI retains all right, title and interest in and to its pre-existing computer systems, hosting platform, software, Content administration tools and general know-how, and hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, transferable license to use, reproduce, modify and sublicense any such HDI materials to the extent incorporated in, or reasonably necessary to use, the Company Materials or the Site. (c) All customer, user, order and transaction data, including customer e-mail lists, collected through the Site or otherwise in connection with Deerskin Products shall be the exclusive property of the Company; HDI may use such data solely as necessary to perform its obligations under this Agreement and shall, upon the Company's request and upon expiration or termination of this Agreement, deliver a copy of such data to the Company in a commercially reasonable format. (d) Nothing in this Agreement shall create any joint ownership of intellectual property, and neither Party acquires any right in the other Party's intellectual property except as expressly granted in this Agreement.

ops.text: 9(c) Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, neither Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall exceed the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable by the Company to HDI under Section 3 in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) One Million Dollars ($1,000,000), and neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. The Company's obligation to make payments under Section 3 shall not be considered damages subject to the foregoing limitation.

The entire-agreement clause (p0069) makes this the complete and exclusive agreement on the subject matter, and the survival clause (p0068) lists only Sections 6.3, 7, 9 and 10 as surviving — none a personnel covenant — so no non-solicit sits inside or outside the four corners, nor survives termination. The deterministic checks for a 12-month duration cap and a general-solicitation carve-out fail only as artifacts of that absence: with no non-solicit clause there is no duration or carve-out to detect, and adding one solely to satisfy the checks would impose a new restriction on our own client, contrary to the playbook. Section 6 (Exclusivity) imposes product/market non-competes on the Company (6.1) and HDI (6.3) and falls under the separate non-compete rule. If HDI later proposes a non-solicit, our fallback is a mutual covenant limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no "no-hire".
